title: Hiring & Offer Management
summary: Final interviews, decisions, offer letters, e-signature and pre-onboarding.
headline: From final interview to *signed offer* in one flow
lede: The last mile is where good candidates are lost. Panels decide with the evidence in front of them, the offer goes out the same day, and pre-onboarding starts when it is signed.

capabilities.title: Final Interview Management
capabilities.body: Plan panel interviews with the right people, a question plan for each interviewer and the candidate’s full history attached.
points: Interview kits built from earlier evidence
Panel availability matched in one step

capabilities.title: Hiring Decisions
capabilities.body: A debrief view with every scorecard side by side, so the decision and the reasons for it are recorded together.
points: Finalists compared on the same criteria
Unsuccessful finalists added to the talent pool

capabilities.title: Offer Letter Generation
capabilities.body: Offer letters produced from approved templates and salary bands, with the figures pulled from the requisition.
points: Templates by country, grade and contract type
Compensation checked against the approved band
Approval chain before anything is sent

capabilities.title: E-Signature Integration
capabilities.body: Candidates sign on any device. You see when the offer was opened, signed or left waiting.
points: Sign on a phone or laptop, no account needed
Signed copy filed to the candidate and your HRMS

capabilities.title: Pre-Onboarding
capabilities.body: Collect documents, run background checks and share first-day details in the gap between signature and start date.
points: Document checklist by role and country
Background check status in the pipeline
New-hire record handed to your HRMS
